Theme.Name: Visual Theme
Theme.Hint: Choose whether LiTM Visual Overhaul leaves the official style untouched or applies the Sci-Fi overhaul.

Accent.Name: Primary Accent Color
Accent.Hint: Hex color used for highlights, active tabs and interface glow. Example: #4de1ff.

Secondary.Name: Secondary Accent Color
Secondary.Hint: Hex color used for secondary neon details. Example: #c45cff.

Glow.Name: Glow Intensity
Glow.Hint: Controls the strength of neon shadows and highlights.

SharpCards.Name: Angular Cards
SharpCards.Hint: Gives cards and panels clipped technological corners.

Scanlines.Name: Subtle Scanlines
Scanlines.Hint: Adds a very light scanline overlay to system windows.

DenseUi.Name: Compact Interface
DenseUi.Hint: Reduces spacing slightly to fit more information on screen.
